DIAGRAM ARCHITECTURE
Immutable content, explicit publication, independent presentation

  INPUT
  AgentChat supplied ASCII                 generateDiagram(generator, request)
  pinned base + complete edit scope        async generation + cancellation checks
                 |                                      |
                 +------------------+-------------------+
                                    v
  +------------------------------------------------------------------------+
  | submitDiagramEdit                                                      |
  | Validate candidate, base revision, scope and node correspondence.       |
  | Whole diagram -> replace; selected subtrees -> scoped patches.          |
  | Retain applicable source mappings or use supplied validated mappings.   |
  +---------------------------------+--------------------------------------+
                                    v
  +------------------------------------------------------------------------+
  | createDiagram / reviseDiagram / deriveDiagram                          |
  | DiagramRevisionEditor prepares edits; issueDiagramRevision freezes.    |
  |                                                                        |
  | DiagramRevision                                                        |
  |   id + diagramId + parentId?                                           |
  |   nodeRefs: parsed content-node ID -> stable logical nodeRef            |
  |   diagram                                                              |
  |     content: ASCII + hash + freeform or parsed tree                     |
  |       tree: hierarchy, coordinates and fold ranges                      |
  |     sourceContext: binding? + contentHash + mappings + evidence         |
  |     jumps? + legacy highlights?                                        |
  +---------------------------------+--------------------------------------+
                                    |
                                    v
                     retainDiagramRevision / revision store
                     explicit retention; get / list / import
                                    |
                  +-----------------+--------------------+
                  |                                      |
                  v                                      v
  CONTENT PUBLICATION                       PRESENTATION CHOICE
  MappingDocumentController                 DiagramAlternative
  apply issued revision                     parts: target scope + source
  or applyRevisionReview                    revision/scope + baseRevisionId
                  |                                      |
  Review: base, candidate, current          select by presentationId
  accept/reject logical-node changes        disjoint parts applied together
  check dependencies and conflicts          nested choice needs active parent
  merge changed fields only                              |
                  |                         alternativeSelections
                  v                                      |
  Update bound content revision             resolveRevisionLines
  reconcile connections and folds                        |
                  |                         projectSelectedDiagramRows
                  v                                      |
  Append canvas history checkpoint          source rows + source coordinates
  expose persistence changes                regular or whole-diagram diff
                                                         |
                                            Bound revision stays unchanged

  PLACEMENT AND DISPLAY
  DiagramNode -> {diagramId, revisionId}
  NodePresentation -> nodeId + geometry + specialized view state
  SidePanel -> one alternative part; regular/diff; flow/overlay; left/right
  Presentation settings -> highlights + marker rules/styles per contentId
  Folding -> logical nodeRefs; presentation edits do not issue content revisions

  IDENTITY AND VALIDATION
  diagramId identifies the diagram; revision.id identifies an immutable record.
  Parsed node IDs belong to content revisions; nodeRefs track proven continuity.
  Source hashes, evidence ranges and mapping references are validated.
  Review application can merge changes; the editor's generic merge rejects drift.

  Source context: diagramRevision*.ts, submitDiagramEdit.ts, diagram*.ts,
  presentation/diagramAlternative.ts, presentation/diagramRevisionProjection.ts,
  mappingDocumentController.ts, generateDiagram.ts, chatDiagramTools.ts
